name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
title: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd - 543952 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue INR5,252m (+22% YoY reported, +2% QoQ cc) with a low-single-digit QoQ rebound promised; FY27 guided only to high single-digit growth and 18–20% EBITDA margin, with a sharp Q4 budget miss from two large clients.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue miss: two clients cut L&D budgets
triggers.quote: A couple of large clients made transient but material reductions to their year-end L&D budgets

triggers.label: FY27 guide high single-digit growth only
triggers.quote: For FY '27, we expect the revenue to grow in high single digits, subject to the macroeconomic environment.

triggers.label: Organic QoQ growth -1% reported, -4% cc
triggers.quote: in reported terms, minus 1% Q-o-Q organic. And in constant currency, it was -- in constant currency, minus 4%.

triggers.label: AI-enabled revenue ~13% of total
triggers.quote: The share of business -- AI-enabled business this quarter was approximately 13%.

triggers.label: Long-term annuity visibility USD 459m
triggers.quote: the revenue visibility improved to USD 459 million. This is up from USD 415 million in the previous quarter

guidance.quote: For FY '27, we expect the revenue to grow in high single digits, subject to the macroeconomic environment.
we expect 18% to 20% EBITDA margin for the full year
Given our investments, we expect 18% margins in the first quarter.

guidance.value: low single-digit QoQ; double-digit YoY opportunity
guidance.quote: in Q1, we have an opportunity to do double-digit.

prior_guidance_check.quote: EBITDA for the year was INR3,957 million at a margin of 20.3%, within our guided range of 20% to 21%

red_flags.label: Q4 miss from budget pullbacks by large clients
red_flags.quote: revenue came in below our expectations. A couple of large clients made transient but material reductions

red_flags.label: Bridge gap on EBITDA and margin questions unanswered
red_flags.quote: We are finding it hard to reconcile the numbers that you are referring to.

red_flags.label: Guidance range wide-open and organic growth dispute
red_flags.quote: whatever numbers we are talking about, they are our best judgment and can swing widely

evasions.quote: So our finance team will work it out for you.

evasions.topic: Implied organic growth in FY27 guide
evasions.quote: whatever numbers we are talking about, they are our best judgment and can swing widely given the uncertainty in the market.
We can ask the same question in 5 different ways.
I don't think we are experts on forex and neither do we claim to them.
